skill: motion-reel (.claude/skills/motion-reel/SKILL.md, with motion-studio/CLAUDE.md, knowledge/README.md and knowledge/our-pipeline.md) plus growth-engine (.claude/skills/growth-engine/SKILL.md, growth-engine/GATES.md, growth-engine/config/organic.json)
version: motion-reel: no version string (knowledge base written 12 Oct 2026). growth-engine: Organic Growth OS and production layer "since 15 Oct 2026". Both ARE installed in this repo.
purpose: motion-reel is the studio's 14-stage A-to-Z workflow (stages 0-13) for code-rendered video (HyperFrames by default, plus the motion-studio canvas engine, Lemo-Opuscar styles, Claude Animation Base and collage B-roll). Its aim is "$10,000" client work from real brand material, references and a measured sound mix. It writes its own script (hook in 2 s, about 2.4 words per second, one alternative hook line) and does NOT call Hook Lab or Script Lab. It generates the voice itself with ElevenLabs. It reviews by self-scored contact sheets plus automatic checks (seekcheck, pacing, audio_qa, safezone, HyperFrames check --caption-zone, Lemo readcheck). Storyboard and preview approval happens only in Guided mode (pauses after stages 4, 5, 7 and 10); Autopilot decides at every gate itself and stops only for paid generation. growth-engine is the weekly organic content engine. Organic OS layers (Brain, Research, Map, Post Cards, Make, Ship, Learn) decide what to make. Every post is a pipeline.py run with Shot Specs and fresh-agent reviews, and a PreToolUse hook blocks Higgsfield and ElevenLabs generation until the gates pass. The GATES.md gates (map ... human) are written into the Post Card; reels are routed to motion-reel in autopilot and finished posts go to the hub as drafts for Matan to approve. config/organic.json holds 21 formats (tier, credits, production family), 8 story_templates and 4 animation_styles. Recommendation: motion-reel should replace motion-video-director, which STANDARDS.md section 12 already retires. To do that, motion-reel must adopt: Hook Lab (organic adapter) for the hook stack, Script Lab (organic adapter) for words and gate, Visual QA M1..M7 with fresh reviewers, the pipeline.py run and prompt registration, and the STANDARDS.md numbers (30 fps, the 35% bottom safe zone, music bed 14-18 dB under the voice, no em dashes anywhere, and a transcript check).

phases.name: Setup (every session; containers are wiped)
phases.does: Runs `bash motion-studio/setup.sh` (renderer deps, Python audio libs, references/ repos, vendored GSAP, HyperFrames CLI; optional tiers lemo, voice, music), copies motion-studio/templates/project to motion-studio/projects/<client>-<piece>, reads motion-studio/CLAUDE.md house rules.
phases.gate: No numeric gate. One folder per deliverable; "Never let two sessions build the same piece in parallel" (SKILL L29-30).
phases.human_checkpoint: none
phases.tools_models: setup.sh (tiers verified in setup.sh L4-6, L98); template files PROJECT.md, brand.md, manifest.json, docs/treatment.md, docs/review_log.md all exist

phases.name: Intake
phases.does: Asks one round of questions, only for what the prompt leaves open: purpose and CTA, audience, platform, length, languages, voiceover yes/no and which voice, brand material, references, must/must-not-say, paid generation and budget. Writes answers and defaults into PROJECT.md.
phases.gate: Defaults: 9:16 master, 30-45 s, plus 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 re-layouts (L36). VO must always be asked, never decided silently (L37).
phases.human_checkpoint: One question round. Autopilot then stops only "to approve paid generation or when something is truly blocked" (L19).

phases.name: Research and asset capture
phases.does: Brand capture via HyperFrames `capture <url>` or Firecrawl branding/screenshot; official logo via the HyperFrames logo resolver or the client's file; self-hosted fonts; assets logged with source and licence in manifest.json; competitor ads (Facebook Ads ads_library_search, Apify), customer words; writes brand.md (colour roles, type for 1080x1920, safe zones, voice).
phases.gate: Never redraw a logo. Every on-screen number has a source and a date in PROJECT.md; no invented numbers, reviews, clients, testimonials or deadlines; examples labelled (L50-51).
phases.human_checkpoint: none
phases.tools_models: HyperFrames CLI capture, Firecrawl firecrawl_scrape, Facebook Ads ads_library_search, Apify

phases.name: References and art direction
phases.does: `refbank.py pick --client <client> --fit <type> --n 6`, opens 2-3 cards, collects 3-6 references in total, and measures each with tools/pacing.py (rest share, quiet runs, transitions, beat rhythm, energy map) plus palette and type sizes. Browses the style menu (447 HyperFrames registry items, Lemo-Opuscar's 43 styles and 98 prompts, Claude Animation Base, collage routes, awesome-design-md). Fills treatment §3 (design read, palette by role, type in motion, layout, ONE signature device, motion vocabulary, texture, sound world, banned list).
phases.gate: 3-6 measured references; one signature device chosen.
phases.human_checkpoint: none

phases.name: Three concepts
phases.does: Writes three concepts with different central visual ideas. Each gets: the picture in one line, the first 2 s, what survives each transition, how the message is physically in the image, style and engine, risk and render cost. Picks the strongest (autopilot) or presents them (guided).
phases.gate: `refbank.py check` must pass. It "fails if the film repeats a used reference, the previous film's category, a signature device from the client's last 3 films, or shares more than one device with the last film" (L82-83). Never reuse the previous client's concept, palette or camera language.
phases.human_checkpoint: Guided mode only: pause after concepts (stage 4) (L20-21)
phases.tools_models: refbank.py check; onetake-principles P3; HyperFrames product-launch-video pitch round

phases.name: Script and voice
phases.does: Script in the client's language with an English check line; hook in the first 2 s; teach or show one thing before the CTA; one idea per line; word budget about 2.4 words/s; one alternative hook line. Voice: ElevenLabs creative_list_voices, then pick or design a voice, then creative_generate_speech, several takes, pick the best; Kokoro only for scratch timing. Word timings go to audio/words.json; pauses go into measured silences. Music plan: ElevenLabs music, the Lemo sampler, the score.py synth or a licensed track; beat grid from beats.py.
phases.gate: Word budget about 2.4 w/s; hook within 2 s; the approved voice is the master clock. There is NO Hook Lab grade, NO Script Lab gate or cold read, NO take cap and NO transcript-vs-script diff.
phases.human_checkpoint: Guided mode only: pause after script and voice (stage 5) (L21)
phases.tools_models: ElevenLabs creative_list_voices / creative_design_voice / creative_generate_speech / creative_transcribe_audio (Scribe); Kokoro (setup.sh voice); motion-studio/beats.py. creative_generate_speech is blocked by the repo PreToolUse generation gate unless the prompt is registered in a pipeline.py run.

phases.name: Treatment and beat sheet
phases.does: Finishes docs/treatment.md: script table and a beat sheet on the voice or beat grid with columns time | beat | voice | on screen | moving | still | link to next | audio.
phases.gate: "beat lengths vary (CV ≥ 0.25, longest ≥ 4x shortest), a real rest after the hook"; every transition names what survives it; every reaction has a visible cause; "nothing important sits frozen > 4 s"; the idea reads with the sound off (L99-101). Optional anthropic-skills:storyboard-qa for claims and timing math.
phases.human_checkpoint: none

phases.name: Styleframes
phases.does: Builds 3-4 key frames in the real engine (hook, a middle beat, the proof or product moment, the end card), renders them with `node motion-studio/stills.mjs --at ...` or HyperFrames snapshot, views them at phone size and scores them with the review_log rubric.
phases.gate: "Fix until every axis is 8+" (L107)
phases.human_checkpoint: Guided mode only: "the approval gate before the expensive part" (L107-108)

phases.name: Build (engine by look)
phases.does: HyperFrames is the master timeline (one sub-composition per scene, client copy as variables, `--batch` for variants). Other engines: the canvas engine (60 fps, 4 subframes); Lemo-Opuscar ported into 9:16 pages, never cropped; Claude Animation Base with the client's own character, never Clawd; collage Route C (free) or Route B (paid). Photoreal comes from client footage first, otherwise ElevenLabs/Higgs generation only with approved spend.
phases.gate: Deterministic pure function of time and `seekcheck.mjs` passes; springs, not easing curves; layouts from brand.md with platform safe zones (house rule: top 250 px, bottom 400 px, right 140 px); body text ≥ 44 px on a 1080-wide frame; a focal point in every frame; the signature device throughout; banned list.
phases.human_checkpoint: Approval for any paid generation
phases.tools_models: HyperFrames (init --resolution portrait), motion-studio render.mjs, Lemo-Opuscar engines, Claude Animation Base (p5.brush), collage method; ElevenLabs/Higgs image, video and 3D generation only with approved spend

phases.name: Sound
phases.does: Voice, music and effects placed from the composition's own event times; fewer sounds than beats; planned silences; a real ending. Music is arranged to the voice, then ducked with a sidechain or the HyperFrames voiceover carve. Master with two-pass loudnorm, then measure.
phases.gate: Voice 10-20 dB above the music; "two-pass loudnorm to -14 LUFS, true peak -1.5 dBTP before encoding" (L137); audio_qa.py (loudness, dropouts, mud, voice-over-music gap) and a spectrogram.
phases.human_checkpoint: "ask the user to listen before final delivery" (L139)
phases.tools_models: projects/straightscale/finish.sh pattern (ffmpeg loudnorm I=-14 TP=-1.5 LRA=11), tools/audio_qa.py, ElevenLabs music, Lemo sampler, score.py

phases.name: Review (gated, at least 3 rounds, logged)
phases.does: Each round goes into docs/review_log.md: a phone-size contact sheet (one frame per beat), strips around every fast moment and transition, the 9-axis scored rubric (hook, readability, motion, continuity, pacing, composition, brand, sound, message with sound off) and the automatic checks; then fix the three worst problems.
phases.gate: "Ship only when every axis is 8+ and every automatic check passes" (L148), or the remaining issue is logged and told to the user. Checks: seekcheck.mjs, pacing.py vs the references, audio_qa.py, safezone.mjs (canvas), HyperFrames check --caption-zone, Lemo readcheck.mjs. Gate list: onetake-principles §8.
phases.human_checkpoint: Guided mode only: pause after the draft cut (stage 10) (L22)
phases.tools_models: same agent self-scores; no fresh reviewer

phases.name: Render and master
phases.does: Drafts: HyperFrames `render --quality draft` or `render.mjs --fps 15 --sub 1`. Final: `render --quality delivery` (`--fps 60` for slick motion) or `render.mjs --fps 60 --sub 4` in 2-3 parallel `--from` segments joined with ffmpeg concat. Then mix, master and mux.
phases.gate: Check frame count, duration, loudness and seams on the final file.
phases.human_checkpoint: none

phases.name: Deliver
phases.does: deliver/vN/ (never overwritten): the 9:16 master plus native 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 re-layouts (never a crop), cutdowns if asked, a viewing copy under 30 MB, poster frame, SRT, contact sheet, CREDITS.md, changelog. Sends files with SendUserFile, commits and pushes, reports what was and wasn't checked, offers the two unused concepts, then runs `refbank.py log` and commits refbank/ledger.json.
phases.gate: Ledger logged before reporting done.
phases.human_checkpoint: User told what nobody has listened to or checked yet (e.g. native-speaker check pending)

phases.name: Revisions
phases.does: Feedback goes into the PROJECT.md decision table; changes are made in the source; the next version renders to deliver/vN+1/ with its changelog.
phases.gate: Re-run the review checks on what changed.
phases.human_checkpoint: Client feedback

phases.name: Client kit (once per client)
phases.does: `hub.py client <slug>` (single source of truth for facts); brand capture; brand-kit.md (carousel-machine Step 0) and the motion brand.md with the same palette and type; style-bible.md locked once; competitors.md with 6-10 accounts; list the real free resources behind keywords.
phases.gate: Only handles seen written on a page tied to the account; unconfirmed ones marked; a keyword CTA needs a real resource.
phases.human_checkpoint: client input on competitors

phases.name: Research (weekly) / OS layer 2
phases.does: OS base set: the last 3 months scored on views with the 4 outlier checks (`organic.py outliers`), plus a weekly refresh and adjacent niches. Runs ig-competitor-research: Apify instagram-scraper (resultsLimit 20), then `rank_and_select.py --days 7 --per-creator 3 --top 12 --rank-by breakout`, sub-agent analysis per pick, and a report.
phases.gate: Ideas adapted to the client's angle, never copied.
phases.human_checkpoint: none
phases.tools_models: Apify connector, ig-competitor-research scripts, organic.py outliers

phases.name: Learn (weekly) / OS layer 7
phases.does: `hub.py results <slug> --days 14`, appended to results-log.md. A post beating the client's baseline 2x becomes templates/<name>/. OS layer 7 adds the scorecard, flags, diagnosis, learnings and budget (`organic.py score`, `ledger`).
phases.gate: Baseline 2x for a template (organic.json: candidate_x 2.0, template_x 3.0).
phases.human_checkpoint: Director weekly memo
phases.tools_models: hub.py results, organic.py score/ledger, analyst agent

phases.name: Map and Post Cards (replaces 'Plan the week')
phases.does: Content Map (belief focus, pillars, series, mix by stage, calendar, live keywords), then one Post Card per slot (job, belief, pillar, series, avatar, demand phrase, format, hypothesis, target) in cards/<yyyy-mm>-W<n>/*.yaml. Default mix for 7 posts: 3 reels, 3 carousels, 1 image. Asks rotate across the week.
phases.gate: `organic.py card-check`, `week-check`, `route`; week_rules: max_images 1, max_same_job_in_a_row 1, min_contrarian 1, min_human_b7 1, conversion_cta_every 5, mix_tolerance 0.2, max_tier_a_per_week 1, story_reels_per_week 1.
phases.human_checkpoint: director approval of the map

phases.name: Make (produce)
phases.does: Each post is a run (`pipeline.py init`) through the 16 steps of production/AI-VIDEO-PIPELINE.md: Shot Spec, fresh prompt review, fresh visual or take review. Reel: motion-reel in autopilot, templates first; copy the final 9:16 MP4 (H.264, AAC, under 100 MB, 3-90 s) as reel.mp4 plus cover.jpg. Carousel: carousel-machine, 1080x1350 JPEG under 8 MB per slide. Caption: under 2,200 characters, 3-5 hashtags. funnel.json for keyword asks.
phases.gate: PreToolUse hook (.claude/hooks/generation_gate.py) denies any Higgs/ElevenLabs generation whose prompt is not registered on a run asset with passed gates; it fails closed.
phases.human_checkpoint: none (stop only for spend beyond the brand-kit budget)
phases.tools_models: pipeline.py, idea/hook/script/carousel agents, video-producer, visual-planner, prompt/visual/take reviewers; adapters hook-lab-organic, script-lab-organic, carousel-machine-organic, animation-organic, ugc-talking-head-organic

phases.name: QA: pre-publish gates and Director batch review
phases.does: The owner of each gate writes pass/fail into the Post Card `gates:` map (map, idea, hook, script, sound_off, visual, originality, truth, conversion, language, budget, human). The Director answers questions 0-6 per post plus a batch check, written to reviews/<week>.md. Reels also get motion-reel stage 10 checks; carousels get carousel-machine step 9.
phases.gate: idea: shock score 5+ and a key visual for the first 3 s. hook: A or A+ on the 3-channel stack, 10 hooks written. script: 30 to 60 s for reach. visual: all ledger gates PASS; safe zones top 14%, bottom 35%, right 21% of the lower half; motion in the first second. budget: 25% retake buffer, premium pieces have 6 assets. Any fail means the post does not go to the hub.
phases.human_checkpoint: language: non-English copy flagged for a native read

phases.name: Ship to the hub
phases.does: item.json, then `hub.py push` (uploads media and creates the draft); `hub.py funnel` for new keywords. Re-pushing with the same external_key updates the draft.
phases.gate: Never post, never switch a business to live.
phases.human_checkpoint: GATES `human`: "Matan approves on the hub's Content page"

phases.name: Hand over
phases.does: Commit and push the client folder (no secrets, no raw scraped media). Report the research, the week's posts and asks, what needs a person, the spend, and anything blocked.
phases.gate: none
phases.human_checkpoint: approvals on the Content page, native read

visual_qa_overlap: What motion-reel already does: styleframes (3-4 key frames rendered in the real engine, viewed at phone size, scored to 8+ on the review_log rubric). Contact sheets with one frame per beat plus strips around every fast moment and transition. stills.mjs pre-render sheets (step 0.5 s). review.sh (contact, strip, phone 360 px, loop). The 9-axis rubric, at least 3 logged rounds, fixing the three worst each round. Automatic checks: seekcheck.mjs (determinism), pacing.py against references, audio_qa.py plus a spectrogram, safezone.mjs (every 0.1 s, text outside zones or under 44 px, canvas engine only), HyperFrames check --caption-zone (and its layout/contrast audits), Lemo readcheck.mjs (reading time). Plus the onetake §8 gate list and the optional storyboard-qa (timing math, causal links, claim tracing). There are no prompt cards: it only logs prompts and terms for paid generation in CREDITS.md. What a fresh-agent reviewer would replace: self-grading (the same agent builds, scores and picks the voice take). What it would add: (a) Visual Reviewer running M1..M7 on motion renders. M1 is a letter-by-letter spelling check including Albanian diacritics; motion-reel only checked glyph coverage. M2 is overlaps and clipping. M3 is safe zones at the STANDARDS zone plus contrast 4.5:1; motion-reel uses a different zone and has no contrast number. M4 checks each text appears on or just before its spoken word, against the words.json timing table; motion-reel follows the VO clock but never verifies it. M5 is motion in the first second and hook text by 0.3 s; motion-reel uses 2 s. M6 is brand colours and fonts only. M7 is G-VIS on any generated image inside the piece. The sampling also changes: frames every 0.5 s plus each cut's start, middle and end (vqa_crops.py motion), and for the final cut every 1.5 s plus every cut, a sound-off watch, transcript and loudness. Motion-reel samples one frame per beat. (b) Prompt Reviewer: needed for every gated generation motion-reel makes (ElevenLabs VO text, ElevenLabs music, Higgs/ElevenLabs plates, collage Route B), because the hook refuses unregistered prompts. (c) Take Reviewer for VO takes: a transcript diff against the approved script (STANDARDS: Scribe or multilingual faster-whisper with language=\"sq\" for Albanian), pace, pauses, pronunciation. Today motion-reel just says \"several takes, pick the best\". (d) A G-FINAL equivalent replacing \"ask the user to listen\" as the only audio sign-off. Keep a human listen as advice, since no agent can hear.
